svg.title: OL-SOVEREIGN cohort plates: white-line blueprint on Chart-sea grounds
svg.desc: Three technical-drawing plates for An Open Letter chs. V-VII: a surveyor's blueprint chart with demarcation lines; a clean-room key schematic with circuit-trace bits; a Beltway-crater specimen cyanotype with a camouflage-twig study. No letterforms baked in; all titles are HTML overlays.
